dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: Everyone said that promotional events would bring in more customers. That's true enough.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: But tricks like that are really only good for getting everyone into the holiday mood. Much better to just keep your prices stable and sell higher volumes with lower profit margins.

dialogues.speaker: Housein
dialogues.text: Dendro Archon, please bless our business going forward. Let our business be even more smooth and stable, let there be no setbacks...
